TransUnions Job Applicant Privacy Notice

Team Overview

We are looking for a ML / LLM Application Engineer to join our AI team and build production ready applications powered by large language models (LLMs). This is a hybrid position and involves regular performance of job responsibilities virtually as well as in-person at an assigned TU office location for a minimum of two days a week.


Role Overview And Core Responsibilities

This role is focused on LLM application development, agent orchestration, and system integration, rather than deep ML research or training models from scratch. You will own end to end delivery of LLM driven features-from design and prototyping to deployment, monitoring, and optimization-working closely with product, platform, and data teams.

Responsibilities

Design, build, and deploy LLM-powered applications using LangChain, LangGraph, and related tooling.
Maintain modular, scalable agent workflows for multi-step reasoning, planning, and tool execution.
Implement and own RAG pipelines, including data ingestion, chunking strategies, embedding workflows, and contextual retrieval.
Develop effective prompting strategies, tool calling logic, memory handling, and guardrails to ensure reliable system behavior.
Integrate LLM applications with vector databases to enable semantic search and contextual intelligence.
Own production considerations such as latency, cost optimization, reliability, and observability.
Collaborate with product, platform, and data teams to translate business requirements into robust AI solutions.
Contribute to architectural decisions, engineering best practices, and reusable patterns for LLM-based systems.



Required Knowledge And Experiences

Required Qualifications

2+ years of experience building production software, with a strong focus on AI-powered or LLM-based applications.
Strong proficiency in Python for building APIs, backend services, AI workflows and maintaining ML pipelines and services.
Solid understanding of machine learning fundamentals, including supervised and unsupervised learning, model evaluation, and feature engineering.
Hands-on experience with at least one machine learning framework or library (e.g., scikit-learn, PyTorch, TensorFlow).
Hands-on experience developing LLM applications using frameworks such as LangChain and/or LangGraph.
Solid understanding of LLM and NLP fundamentals, including embeddings, transformers, vector similarity search, and prompt design.
Practical experience implementing retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems.
Experience integrating vector databases (e.g., FAISS, Pinecone, Weaviate, or similar).
Experience deploying and operating production systems, including Docker, REST APIs, and CI/CD pipelines.
Strong problem-solving skills and ability to independently own features while collaborating across teams.

Good to Have

Experience working with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud.
Familiarity with distributed systems, async processing, or microservice architectures.
Exposure to MLOps practices, including model evaluation, experiment tracking, monitoring, and rollback strategies.
Experience handling largescale structured and unstructured data.
Exposure to multimodal LLM applications (text + image, audio, or video).

Familiarity with lightweight model adaptation techniques (e.g., inference optimization, prompt tuning, LoRA) is a plus.

Job Summary

We are seeking an experienced Prompt Engineer with 5+ years of overall experience and deep expertise in designing, optimizing, and evaluating prompts for Large Language Models (LLMs). The ideal candidate will work closely with AI/ML engineers, data scientists, product managers, and business stakeholders to build reliable, scalable, and high-quality Generative AI solutions.

Create reusable prompt templates and prompt libraries for enterprise use

Experience with LLM APIs (OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Vertex AI, etc.)
Solid understanding of NLP concepts, transformers, embeddings, and tokenization
Experience with RAG architectures, vector databases (FAISS, Pinecone, Weaviate)
Proficiency in Python and familiarity with LangChain / LlamaIndex / Semantic Kernel
Knowledge of prompt evaluation frameworks and hallucination mitigation techniques



Domain & Soft Skills

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
Ability to translate business requirements into effective prompt designs
Excellent communication and documentation skills
Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments
Stakeholder management and collaboration skills

Good to Have

Experience in BFSI, Healthcare, Retail, or Enterprise SaaS domains
Exposure to AI agents, tools/function calling, and workflow orchestration
Understanding of LLM fine-tuning and parameter-efficient training (LoRA, adapters)
Experience with multi-modal models (text, image, audio)
Familiarity with responsible AI frameworks and compliance standards

Education

Opportunity to work on cutting-edge Generative AI solutions
High-impact role with business and technical visibility

Competitive compensation and flexible work options
